test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Pipe P can fill a tank in 12 hours, and pipe Q can empty the same tank in 18 hours. If both pipes are opened simultaneously, in how many hours will the tank be full?
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe P fills tank in 12 hours

Pipe Q empties tank in 18 hours

**Formula used:**

LCM = Total work

Efficiency = Work / Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 12 and 18 = 36 (Total work)

⇒ P efficiency = 36 / 12 = 3 units/hour

⇒ Q efficiency = 36 / 18 = 2 units/hour (emptying)

⇒ Net efficiency = 3 − 2 = 1 unit/hour

⇒ Time = 36 / 1 = 36 hours

**∴ Tank will be full in 36 hours**
